title: Learning Speech Attribute Representations via Multi-Teacher Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent post-training approaches have shown that self-supervised speech encoders can be adapted to learn a single utterance-level speech attribute through knowledge distillation. In this work, we investigate whether a single speech encoder can simultaneously preserve multiple complementary utterance-level speech representations. We propose a multi-attribute multi-teacher distillation framework that learns semantic, speaker, language, and emotion representations from four frozen teacher models using a shared SSL backbone and attribute-specific branches. Experiments on multilingual semantic retrieval, speaker verification, language identification, and speech emotion recognition show that the proposed model achieves performance close to dedicated single-task students while requiring only a single shared encoder. Furthermore, the learned layer aggregation strategies reveal that different speech attributes naturally emerge at different depths

translated_title: 通过多教师蒸馏学习语音属性表示
translated_abstract: 近期的后训练方法表明，自监督语音编码器可以通过知识蒸馏来学习单一的语句级语音属性。在本工作中，我们研究了单个语音编码器能否同时保留多种互补的语句级语音表示。我们提出了一种多属性多教师蒸馏框架，该框架使用共享的自监督学习（SSL）骨干网络和针对特定属性的分支，从四个冻结的教师模型中学习语义、说话人、语言和情感表示。在多语言语义检索、说话人验证、语言识别和语音情感识别上的实验表明，所提出的模型在仅需要一个共享编码器的情况下，达到了接近专门单任务学生模型的性能。此外，学习到的层聚合策略揭示出不同的语音属性自然地出现在不同的网络深度。
tldr: 本文提出多属性多教师蒸馏框架，利用单个共享SSL编码器同时学习语义、说话人、语言和情感四种语音属性表示，性能接近专门的单任务模型，并发现不同语音属性自然涌现于不同的网络深度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-attribute multi-teacher distillation framework that uses a single shared SSL encoder to simultaneously learn semantic, speaker, language, and emotion representations, achieving performance close to dedicated single-task models while revealing that different speech attributes naturally emerge at different network depths.
